items.title: Queer Artists Say Tom of Finland Foundation Has Lost Its Way
items.summary: Former artist residents of the LA nonprofit fear leadership has strayed from the radical, queer energy that Tom and his house embody.

items.title: Mala Iqbal Paints the Space We Share With Strangers
items.summary: Her new paintings remind us that the world is a room we share with strangers, most of whom are looking elsewhere.

items.title: British Museum to Provide Bayeux Tapestry Audio Tour After Lawsuit
items.summary: Yusuf Ali Osman, a man with no sight, filed a suit against the museum under the UK's anti-discrimination Equality Act.
